proves.claim: On a board with no execution engine version, a builder accept with every solo low-stakes fact true is admitted and writes its solo-low-stakes-accept event.

store.io-board-verify.solo-accept-live-b.why: Without it the verify table skipped a live board, so the builder accept was refused SELF_VERIFY after every fact held (#11356).

proves.claim: On the same board the builder accept stays refused SELF_VERIFY with the setting off, a team row or an unproved check.

store.io-board-verify.solo-refused-live-.why: Without it the live-board fix could widen the self-accept past low-stakes rows with a proven check.
